tagline: Outdoor power equipment for Milton's farmers and locals
heroSubheading: Your local source for STIHL chainsaws, farm vehicles, and outdoor power equipment.
aboutHtml:
STIHL SHOP Milton is owned and run by John Taal, a long-time member of this community. We're specialists in power equipment for farming and forestry work, with real expertise in STIHL chainsaws and CanAm vehicles. We know what locals need to get the job done.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Honda, Rover, Cub Cadet, Briggs & Stratton, CanAm, and Ironman 4x4 Accessories. Whether you're buying new, need parts, or want advice on the right machine for the job, we're here to sort you out. Pop in and have a chat with us about what you need.

We're proud to support local schools, service groups, and sports clubs that help build our community. Shopping with us means backing a locally-owned Kiwi business.
servicesIntro: Workshop servicing, parts stock, and expert technical advice.
